en.headline: 3 own commits, 18 automated, 4 issue actions, 1 discussion reply
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, `sogeisetsu` recorded **3 own commits** across two repositories, plus 18 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the two own commits updated the agents docs to clarify commit-attribution aliases and fixed the daily script so commit attribution supports aliases, including non-GitHub-account email addresses. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, a single chore commit tagged the release as `v1.15.5`. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded. Issue activity totaled 4 actions in `openchamber/openchamber`: opened issue #4920 about the context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input so `其他` is always 0%; commented on issue #4111 about deleting a multi-run leaving orphaned MCP child processes and `git worktree remove --force` failing with Permission denied; and both commented on and closed issue #4346 regarding `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`. The user also joined an existing discussion, #4821 in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel" (Ideas category, 1 comment). No section hit its collection cap.

zh.headline: 3 次本人提交、18 次自动提交、4 次 issue 操作、1 条讨论回复
zh.summary: 2026-10-15，`sogeisetsu` 在两个仓库中完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 18 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，均位于 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次本人提交分别更新了 agents 文档以说明提交归属别名，并修复了 daily 脚本，使提交归属支持别名，兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，一次 chore 提交将版本标记为 `v1.15.5`。当日无 PR、无 review、无 release。issue 活动共 4 次，全部发生在 `openchamber/openchamber`：新开 issue #4920，指出上下文面板的 breakdown 条把整段会话的估算除以最后一条消息的输入，导致 `其他` 始终为 0%；在 issue #4111 上留言，讨论删除多运行后遗留的 MCP 子进程以及 `git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied 的问题；并对 issue #4346 留言并关闭，该 issue 涉及 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 仍然通过。此外，用户参与了一条已有讨论，即 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4821，标题为 "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel"（Ideas 分类，共 1 条评论）。所有分区均未触及采集上限。
